edits.value_json: "Illegal behavior tests: cmd_payload=0 when cmd handshake, command valid while busy, and wrong input channel ready&&valid transfer in non-owning phase each produce one-cycle error and recover to continue legal operation. Valid asserted alone while ready=0 in a non-owning phase is legal backpressure observation and must not error."
edits.reason: Aligns acceptance criterion with existing transfer-triggered error semantics and phase-gated ready signals; resolves ambiguity identified in feedback.

issue: Clarified illegal wrong-channel condition as attempted transfer (ready&&valid) only; valid-only during backpressure is non-error per existing control/interface rules.
